meta.description: Automate Agility CMS tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动执行 Agility CMS 的内容管理任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要手动操作 Agility CMS 的内容管理
copy.tagline_en: Automate content management tasks in Agility CMS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manually manage content in Agility CMS

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动完成 Agility CMS 的内容管理任务，如发布文章、更新条目等。它会先搜索最新工具，检查连接状态，再执行操作。
howto.when: 当你要求对 Agility CMS 进行内容操作（如发布、更新、列出内容）时触发。Claude 会先搜索可用工具并确认连接有效。

say.text: 在 Agility CMS 中发布最近编辑的文章。
say.note: Claude 会搜索工具并执行发布操作。

say.text: 列出 Agility CMS 中所有标题包含“新闻”的内容条目。
say.note: Claude 会先发现相关工具再查询。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate Agility CMS tasks such as publishing articles or updating entries. It first searches for current tool schemas, verifies connection status, then executes actions.
howto.when_en: When you request Agility CMS operations like publish, update, or list content. Claude first discovers available tools and checks connection before proceeding.

say_en.text: Publish recently edited articles in Agility CMS.
say_en.note: Claude will search tools and execute the publish action.

say_en.text: List all content entries in Agility CMS with 'news' in the title.
say_en.note: Claude discovers relevant tools then queries.
